status: exploratory analysis protocol fixed after earlier outcomes were inspected; not preregistration
primary_application_question: Which sharing-rule comparisons and fee trade-offs are supported by the actual price-rule support, and which require functional-form or participation assumptions?
population: all 360 exported records for pooled model diagnostics; factual provenance unchanged
identification_checks: exact price-by-sharing support graph and effective utility-design ranks
identify price-rule cell contrasts without imposing linear fee
compare full A/B/outside models with conditional A/B models
distinguish rule-package contrasts from a pure control mechanism
keep amount trade-offs within observed support and report assumptions
fixed_model_family: conditional A/B logit on observed price-rule cells
random service-intercept panel logit with linear and cell utilities
two-class preference mixture with class-specific price and sharing coefficients
comparison_rules: same respondent-level five folds, all eight answers held out together
fixed multistart rules, no heldout-outcome initialization
joint response log score and separate marginal score targets
compare model classes before giving behavioral names
source metadata used for provenance diagnostics, never silently relabelled as verified human responses
no choice of model or subgroup solely to obtain significance
readiness_requirements: a substantive contribution distinguished from existing app-purchase and health-data-governance DCE studies
valid source and recruitment statements; appropriate research/ethics statements
identified estimands and matched model assumptions
numerical and predictive validation with limitations attached to claims
manuscript and reproducibility materials consistent with the supported evidence

follow_up_amendment.reason: Participation and preference mixtures approached a deterministic all-outside boundary. All 42 all-outside records share one original export source label.
follow_up_amendment.models: Added a classical exact all-outside point-mass mixture to replace arbitrary large-intercept boundaries; assessed the other-source 300-record subset as a sensitivity population.
follow_up_amendment.source_update: Researcher reports that the platform described the service as human recruitment; this is recorded as reported provenance. No source label is deleted or silently reclassified.
follow_up_amendment.inference: Exploratory, post-outcome amendment. Source concentration is an observation, not a demonstrated causal mechanism or proof of nonhuman respondents.
